name: Teaching Gender-Affirming Care
source:
Welcome to Rose Way Clinic!

You're hired as a new physician to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to eight transgender and gender-diverse patients across 18 encounters. 

Your decisions influence patient trust and stress. As a new provider, you'll prescribe hormone therapy, manage complex cases, build patient relationships, and receive mentorship from in-game coaches. 

[From [url=https://stanfordedtech.itch.io/teaching-gender-affirming-care]itch.io[/url]]
